(b) The SPACING was independently wrong: R pads elements to the width of the widest element, so five single-digit values print as [1] 3 7 1 9 5 with single spaces; the doubled spacing shown belongs to a vector containing a two-digit element such as 10. name: yogi.xml
defect3_content_added: SAME SIBLING PATTERN CONFIRMED: the file had NO screening whatsoever. Added a PrePracticeScreen with 5 questions (eye/cardiac/spine/bone/joint conditions, pregnancy and trimester, surgery within 6 months and its restrictions, current pain versus tightness with radiating symptoms, exertional dizziness or palpitations), an AskingRule scaling the screen to what the sequence contains, a SilenceRule stating that silence is not a negative answer, and a NoScreenNoInversionRule that experience level cannot override

new ContraindicationRegister with 10 entries, each carrying Fires, Why, Substitute and Specialty: glaucoma and retinal problems (inversions and head-below-heart, plus retention; substitute legs-up-the-wall; ophthalmologist), uncontrolled hypertension and cardiac (inversions, all retention including 4-7-8 and box breathing, kapalabhati, prolonged overhead holds), cervical spine disease (shoulderstand, plow, headstand; flagged as the highest-consequence entry since the mechanism is silent and the pose is taught as restful), pregnancy (deep closed twists, prone backbends, deep abdominal work, retention, prolonged supine after mid-pregnancy, new inversions, relaxin end-range), lumbar disc and sciatica (loaded flexion, roll-downs, morning flexion; with the explicit boundary that which direction helps is a clinical determination), osteoporosis (spinal flexion, deep twists), recent surgery and joint replacement (surgeon's protocol governs; hip replacement's prohibited directions map onto pigeon, deep squats, cross-legged sitting and supine figure-four while feeling gentle), panic and anxiety disorders (retention and forced breathing provoke the interoceptive sensations panic attaches to), epilepsy (hyperventilatory pranayama lowers seizure threshold), hypermobility (the inverse case: risk is that the pose is too available). Plus a ResidualRule that an unlisted condition is unassessed, not cleared

new SensationVsPainProtocol: Expected sensations (broad, muscle-belly, dull, easing), a STOP NOW list (sharp, electrical, radiating along a line, joint rather than muscle, numbness, tingling, anything increasing with hold time, anything in the neck under load, anything persisting after coming out), the single instruction attached to all of them (come out, do not go back in today, have it assessed if it recurs), an Asymmetry note on which way the errors run, and a NeverSay list
new PRINCIPLE 'Screen Before Sequence'
new PRINCIPLE 'Remove and Substitute, Do Not Annotate' explaining why a caveat beside a pose gets practised through: the format signals the pose as the instruction and the note as commentary
new PRINCIPLE 'A Cue Is Not a Claim' distinguishing a mechanical statement the practitioner can verify in a second from a physiological effect claim
new PRINCIPLE listen-to-your-body-is-not-a-safety-instruction, naming the two cases it fails: sensation that feels fine and is doing damage, and sensation that feels alarming and is harmless

SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS safety boundaries: screen-before-sequence, remove-and-substitute, no movement into current pain, pranayama as physiological intervention with its full contraindication set, no therapeutic claims including soft forms, never suggest reducing medical treatment, and 6 referral triggers including cauda equina symptoms stated as an emergency

6 new BehavioralGuidance situations: current pain (changes response type, not pose selection, and the stretch reflex is wrong as often as right), pregnancy stated or plausible, recent surgery (the surgeon's protocol governs and a pose can violate it while feeling like rest), therapeutic request (the traditional answer is often both unsupported and the riskiest pose available), and group class (screening burden moves to the teacher; no whole-class inversion in an unscreened room)
new mandatory SCREEN phase as Phase 1 with a three-list output (STATED, RULED OUT, UNKNOWN), striking fired poses from the candidate set before drafting rather than removing them after

new Contraindication Handling (100%) and Claim Discipline (100%) quality dimensions

example_defects_found: FLAGSHIP POSITIVE EXAMPLE PRESCRIBED BREATH RETENTION TO AN UNSCREENED BEGINNER: 4-7-8 breathing is a 7-count kumbhaka, contraindicated in uncontrolled hypertension, pregnancy, glaucoma, epilepsy and panic disorder, none of which had been asked about. This is the sibling-file pattern in its exact form, inside the file's own model of a good session
the same 4-7-8 line carried the physiological claim 'this pattern signals your nervous system to slow down', stated more strongly than the evidence supports, in a file that forbids therapeutic claims

positive example ended with savasana 'lie flat, arms relaxed' for a practitioner whose stated complaint was lower back tightness. Lying with legs extended tips the pelvis and deepens the lumbar arch, so the closing pose was the one most likely to aggravate the exact condition the session was built around. Fixed to knees bent, feet on floor, with the mechanical reason

positive example omitted the Peak and Integrate layers entirely while its own Why asserted 'Prerequisite Decomposition satisfied: chain stated and followed', against a 100% dimension defined as no layer skipped. A circular self-certification over an actual violation

positive example's Why claimed 'Breath Integration satisfied by specific cues at every transition' when savasana and several section transitions had no breath cue at all: a second false claim in the same commentary block

TIME ARITHMETIC (A2 self-consistent fabrication analog): the example was labelled 30 minutes and its content computed to roughly 14. At ~6 sec per breath, 6 rounds cat-cow plus 5 breaths per side of two poses plus 8 min savasana plus centering is about 13 to 14 minutes. The label matched the request, which is why it passed unexamined. Rebuilt to 3+5+7+4+4+6+1 = 30 with per-section minute labels that sum

positive example accepted 'lower back tightness' at face value with no distinction from pain and no question about radiating symptoms, which is precisely the screening gap that would let a sequence be built for a disc herniation

positive example's Triangle Why was anatomically imprecise: it attributed the risk to the lower back ROUNDING, which is a forward-fold mechanism. In Triangle the pelvis tips and the spine side-bends and rotates simultaneously to cover the distance, and side-bend plus rotation under load is the actual vulnerability. Corrected

edge_case handstand example screened only for 'shoulder, wrist, or neck conditions', omitting glaucoma, retinal problems, hypertension, cardiac history, osteoporosis and pregnancy: it screened for the joints you feel and not the pressures you do not, which is the characteristic shape of an inadequate screen

edge_case handstand example specified 'wall-assisted kick-up with spotting cues' for a practitioner who gave no indication of having a spotter; replaced with wall work plus a bail-out taught before the entry

VersionDependenceBothSides: source-side era reading (Streams implies Java 8+, AsyncTask implies pre-coroutines) and target-side era (mapping into class components or AngularJS dates the candidate on the resume meant to prove currency), with a mismatch rule and an uncertainty rule preferring durable concepts over library names
Principle: a number belongs to its metric, not to the bullet
Principle: some things do not transfer and saying so is the skill
three new BehavioralGuidance decisions: concept_does_not_transfer, metric_changes_during_translation, version_era_mismatch
TRUTH PASS added as the first step of the Critique phase, before any scoring
example_defects_found: A2 CENTRAL, edge_case example: carried the 35% from build times to delivery cycle time, keeping the digit while changing what it measured. Impact Fidelity as written passed this because the number survived. Metric restored to build time and the anchor rewritten as three conditions

edge_case Plan called Architected upgraded to Designed, but the file own seniority ladder puts architected at senior and designed below it, so this was a downgrade described as an upgrade while Impact Fidelity requires equivalent verb weight; changed to Led the design of

positive example mapped eliminating null pointer exceptions to mitigating runtime errors through optional chaining and strict type safety, conflating a compile-time flag (strictNullChecks, types erased at runtime) with a runtime operator that yields undefined rather than preventing bad access; rewritten as hardening against with the layer change made explicit
positive example Why scored Idiomatic Accuracy 100% and Paradigm Correctness 100% although the top anchor for both is 95%, an unanchored and unfalsifiable score

positive example force-mapped Java arrays-to-Lists whole, when the collections-API half has no counterpart in a language with one Array type; now a documented partial transfer with the non-carrying half named and dropped
AntiExample WhyWrong claimed three violations; six of the eight dimensions fail, and Impact Fidelity survives only by luck because that source bullet happens to contain no numbers
other_fixes: systematic 5-versus-8 dimension mismatch: QUICK_START said five dimensions, SELF_REFINE Cycle and QualityThreshold listed five, ITERATIVE_PROCESS listed five, INSTRUCTIONS Critique said five, SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS Phase 4 said five, while QUALITY_DIMENSIONS defines eight and ConvergenceHeuristics already referenced a ninth-named dimension outside the five. All six sites reconciled to eight

ConvergenceHeuristics signal 1 explicitly permitted delivering below threshold because clean output cannot disclose a limitation; inverted into a Gate, since an undisclosed defect on a resume is worse than asking one question
METRICS carried Improvement vs. Baseline >= 20%, an unmeasurable target; replaced with a reproducible count (Naive Substitution Delta) plus five countable zero-target observational rows
SELF_REFINE given authoritative=true

three new ErrorRecovery entries: idiomatic-but-false, metric drift, verb weight drift
five new PROMPT_TESTING scenarios including non-transferable concept testing, where a fluent plausible target bullet is the failure case
cross-references verified: Section 3/CONTEXT and Section 5/SELF_REFINE both resolve; all v4 sections present including POLISH_FOR_PUBLICATION and non-optional TONE_AND_STYLE
assessment: Two systemic faults: the file counted five dimensions in six places while defining eight, and its own Impact Fidelity rule licensed the exact fabrication its edge-case example commits, carrying 35 percent from build time onto a metric nobody measured.

name: virtual_event_planner.xml
defect3_content_added: TimezoneArithmetic block: UTC as anchor with local times derived, the DST transition dates for US, EU, Australia (opposite direction) and the no-DST zones, the March and late-October windows where the habitual New York to London offset is wrong by an hour, a requirement to show conversions rather than assert them, a requirement to name which region draws the worst slot, .ics and real zone identifiers rather than ambiguous abbreviations, and production crew coverage against the UTC span

BudgetArithmetic block requiring lines to sum to subtotal, contingency as a stated percentage of subtotal, subtotal plus contingency to equal total, per-attendee derived by division, comparison against any ceiling, duration-scaled costs computed from actual agenda live hours, plus a worked closing budget

PlatformClaimDiscipline: every capacity claim needs product, tier, and verification route; headcount divided by participant ceiling with coverage percentage stated; product-line distinction within a single vendor; a Verify-before-build list with owners

expanded AccessibilityRequirements: ASR versus human CART with cost per live hour and glossary ownership, screen reader compatibility as a platform selection criterion with the surfaces to test named, recording availability with caption correction and retention, interpretation staffing, low-bandwidth path, and failure planning for accessibility services themselves

ContingencyFailureModes: eight concrete production-day failures each with owner by role and decision threshold, including the failover channel problem that the platform carrying the message may be the thing that failed
arithmetic pass added as a distinct Critique step and to FinalPassActions
two new Principles (time zone arithmetic is where virtual events actually fail; a capacity claim is a number someone will rely on)
example_defects_found: positive example stated UTC blocks (APAC 00:00-04:00, EMEA 08:00-12:00, NA 16:00-20:00) and never converted them to any local time, so nothing in the schedule was checkable and the 05:30 start in Bengaluru was invisible behind the label APAC
positive example contained no DST consideration at all in a file whose domain hint identifies DST boundaries as the genuine failure point
positive example agenda block held a keynote, two track sessions and networking, roughly 110 minutes, inside a stated 240-minute block, leaving about two hours unallocated

positive example critique named that timing gap and then recorded it resolved by adding 5-minute transition buffers: a 15-minute fix to a 130-minute gap, with the trail certifying that timing had been checked

positive example showed no budget at all while Budget-ROI Alignment is a 100% gate requiring every tool to have a line, and its REVISIONS APPLIED claimed to have added a Braindate license to a budget framework that does not appear

positive example asserted 'Slido scales to 1,000+ simultaneous responses' from recollection with no tier named, in a file whose own tool rules require capacity claims be cross-referenced against scale
positive example implied a 20-hour production window (00:00 to 20:00 UTC) with no crew accounted for anywhere

edge case proposed a polling free tier explicitly described as capped at 100 live participants for an 800-employee all-hands, presented under 'no additional platform cost', giving 12.5 percent coverage of the room while the stated executive goal was high participation
edge case skeleton listed four sections and tagged Section 8 as [D: S4] while Section 4 was not in the skeleton, a dangling dependency in the artefact whose job is to be the structural contract
edge case asserted breakout rooms on a webinar product, a capability that is product-line, tier, and version dependent within a single vendor
other_fixes: QUICK_START said 'four mandatory phases' while SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS lists six, the exact pattern named in the brief

dimension count wrong in five places: QUICK_START Setup, QUICK_START QualityBar, SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS Phase 4, INSTRUCTIONS Integrate, and RECAP said six or nine while QUALITY_DIMENSIONS defines eight; the 'nine' came from counting the METRICS table including User Satisfaction

SELF_REFINE Cycle enumerated the critique dimensions as six by name, omitting Skeleton-First Compliance and Process Integrity, both of which are 100% hard gates: a gate that is never on the sheet is never waived and never audited
SELF_REFINE QualityThreshold named only two of the four 100% gates
Proposal Completeness had threshold 100% with a top anchor of '95%+', structurally unreachable
flat 85% soft threshold in four places when Global Accessibility and Technical Feasibility are both 90%
ConvergenceHeuristics allowed a phrasing-only signal to stop with hard gates outstanding, and used an unmeasurable 'under 2% improvement'
FLEXIBILITY and TONE_AND_STYLE both let a minimal-output request drop Sections 6 and 8, failing two 100% gates including Budget-ROI Alignment, by deleting accessibility and the budget
METRICS 'at least 20% higher stakeholder approval rate' replaced with seven countable checks plus eight new count-based metrics
added five Error Recovery entries covering unverifiable capacity, unclosable agenda gaps, budget totals that do not match their lines, and unstaffable production windows
Skeleton-First Compliance anchor now requires the dependency graph to be well formed, not merely to exist
TONE_AND_STYLE optional=true set to false
assessment: Every timezone conversion and budget total in the file was recomputed: the original asserted UTC blocks with no conversions and no DST logic at all, its agenda block was two hours short of its stated length with the shortfall recorded as fixed by a five-minute buffer, its 100 percent budget gate was demonstrated by an example containing no budget, and its edge case offered an 800-person all-hands a polling tool capped at 100.

name: youtube_video_analyst.xml
defect3_content_added: new EvidenceProvenanceProtocol in CONTEXT with 4 tiers governing which output elements exist at all: Tier A (timestamped transcript) supports quotes and MM:SS, Tier B (untimestamped transcript) supports quotes but NO timestamps of any kind, Tier C (excerpt) supports analysis of the excerpt only and no claims about the overall thesis, Tier D (title, description, comments, bare link) supports NO analysis. Plus a MixedInputRule preventing strong provenance on one section from lending credibility to another, and an ObservationBoundary listing 5 classes of sentence no text input can support at any tier (what was shown, delivery and tone, production, reception, and speaker identity where the transcript lacks labels)

new AttributionGrammar in CONTEXT with 5 rules: grammatical attribution on every substantive claim, exact preservation of epistemic strength, preservation of scope conditions with the number they attach to, neutral reporting verbs with a named list of the verdict-carrying ones to avoid, and the report-the-assertion-and-stop rule for contested claims
new PRINCIPLE 'You Did Not Watch It' naming the register of having-watched as the mechanism of the failure
new PRINCIPLE 'Quotation Marks Are a Promise About Characters', including that cleaning a quote is editing a quote
new PRINCIPLE 'A Number Without an Anchor Is a Different Number Tomorrow' covering views, engagement, watch time and algorithm behaviour

SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS safety boundaries rebuilt: cannot watch or retrieve, no hedged analysis from a link, timestamps come from the source or do not exist and are never computed or interpolated, quotation marks only around copied strings, no metrics or algorithm claims, preserve the speaker's hedges as content, and report-what-is-claimed-never-whether-it-is-true
new mandatory ESTABLISH PROVENANCE phase as Phase 1, with the rule that the response template never overrides what the source supports

new INSTRUCTIONS steps: copy quotable strings rather than typing them from memory of the source; record hedges and scope conditions during Understand so they survive compression; a source-trace pass run draft-to-source rather than source-to-draft; a hedge-restoration pass; and a word count performed rather than estimated with the number written down

6 new BehavioralGuidance situations: link or title only (the failure is generating the plausible version and labelling it, not refusing), transcript without timestamps, questions about views and algorithm performance, claims that are wrong or harmful (report in neutral attribution, safety note kept outside the analysis body), and garbled auto-transcripts (which mangle proper nouns and numbers specifically, the elements the analysis wants to quote)
new Timestamp Integrity (100%) and Attribution Discipline (100%) quality dimensions, plus Process Integrity newly defined
new POLISH_FOR_PUBLICATION section (17-item checklist, 5 FinalPassActions) and ORIGINAL_PROMPT section, both absent

7 new PROMPT_TESTING tests: provenance, timestamp integrity, quote fidelity with disfluent speech, hedge preservation at the tightest word target, metrics refusal, visual boundary, and a ten-run word count audit checking for the low-eighties cluster
example_defects_found: FLAGSHIP POSITIVE EXAMPLE INVENTED FOUR TIMESTAMPS: its Input was a DESCRIPTION of a transcript ('including timestamped lines about...') that supplied no times whatsoever, and the Output produced [00:00], [03:45], [08:30] and [14:00]. Four fabricated timestamps in a file whose first stated rule is never to invent one, inside its own model of correct output. Input replaced with an actual Tier A transcript so the markers are earned

FLAGSHIP POSITIVE EXAMPLE INVENTED A VERBATIM QUOTE: 'The model does not replace the radiologist, it gives them superhuman pattern recognition' was placed in quotation marks and attributed to a [03:45] timestamp, manufactured from a source containing no quotations at all. This is the peer-review-file pattern in its exact form

WORD COUNT FAILURE, the file's single most mechanically checkable constraint: the positive example's summary is 81 words against a stated 90-110 floor, and its own Why block certifies 'Word count within 90-110'. Verified by script. Rewritten to 98, also verified by script
positive example asserted 'Three years of model training on medical imaging', a duration nowhere in the input

positive example asserted an equity theme ('close the quality gap between elite centers and rural hospitals') that appears nowhere in the input and is simply what a talk on this topic tends to contain: the 80%-anchor drift toward the topic's general shape

positive example's Why claimed 'Every breakdown entry has a verified timestamp' and 'Source-faithful throughout, no external claims injected', both circular self-certifications and both flatly false against the same example

ATTRIBUTION FAILURE the new dimension was written for: the example rendered a doubly-qualified prediction as 'Full adoption is projected within five years' and 'Universal AI-assisted diagnostics within five years', unhedged, unscoped and universal. It also rendered a two-site turnaround result as '40% faster diagnosis times', collapsing turnaround into diagnosis and dropping both the site scope and the flat-accuracy caveat. The number was real, which is what made it the hardest error to see

AntiExample commentary stated its summary was '~35 words' when an actual count is 22: an unchecked count inside the critique of an example about unchecked counts. Corrected, and the lesson folded into the WhyWrong
AntiExample's two timestamps ([01:30], [06:00]) match nothing in the source, a Timestamp Integrity failure the original commentary did not notice because it read as a mere quality problem

edge_case example was not an output at all but a bracketed DESCRIPTION of one ('[Domain signal triggered: ...] The summary presents...'), so it demonstrated nothing checkable, and it described analysing a 45-minute debate while showing no source. Replaced with two real edge cases: the Tier D link-only refusal with the specific transcript retrieval path, and the no-timestamps-plus-metrics-question case

added a second AntiExample: a Tier D reconstruction of 'The Hidden Cost of Microservices' that is the best-written passage in the file, with an italic 'based on the title' caveat, three plausibly-spaced fabricated timestamps, a fabricated quotable line, an invented engagement claim, and an invented biographical detail. Its WhyWrong names the tell: reconstructions are always unhedged, because invented claims have no original qualifiers to preserve
other_fixes: defect B flat threshold: SELF_REFINE had NO QualityThreshold element; the blanket 'others 85%+' appeared in 4 places (QUICK_START QualityBar, SELF_REFINE Cycle step 4, INSTRUCTIONS step 9, ITERATIVE_PROCESS step 4) and contradicted Completeness at 90%. All replaced with the explicit per-dimension list and the missing element added

defect B: ConvergenceHeuristics had no gate; added one noting that every failure of the four 100% dimensions is repaired by REMOVING something, so 'we have iterated enough' is never the right response to them
defect B: FLEXIBILITY had no non-overridable clause; added one blocking 'just do your best from the link', 'estimate the timestamps', and word-count reduction from cutting attributions or hedges

defect C: QUALITY_DIMENSIONS defined 6 while METRICS scored 7, and they were not the same set: Analytical Depth was defined but never scored, while Process Integrity and User Satisfaction (unmeasurable >= 4/5) were scored but never defined. Reconciled at 8 defined and 8 scored, User Satisfaction removed

defect C: Word Count Precision had threshold='100 +/- 10', a range, while its anchors were percentages, making the dimension unscoreable on its own scale. Restated as a 90% threshold with the range as the pass condition and an added 100% anchor requiring the count be recorded
defect C: mandatory phase count went 4 to 5 with the ESTABLISH PROVENANCE insertion; MandatoryPhases, INSTRUCTIONS phases and the Process Integrity anchor all reconciled

TONE_AND_STYLE optional=true set to false, with a Register subsection on the register of having-watched, which arrives in the confident prose of genuine familiarity and so does not feel like invention while being written
ConflictResolutionProtocol: added the missing Guidance element and extended Priority 1 to cover timestamp integrity, attribution discipline, the response template, and explicit user requests
METRICS measurement methods rewritten from restated definitions into countable checks, three of them counts that must be zero

6 new ErrorRecoveryProtocol recoveries, including: an unlocatable detail is deleted not softened, and its neighbours re-checked since details from general knowledge arrive in clusters; a nearly-verbatim tidied quote loses its marks or is fully restored with disfluencies; the word ceiling yields to hedges by dropping a claim; a drafted Tier D analysis is discarded rather than caveated; and the response template yields to the source on timestamps

RESPONSE_FORMAT: added a provenance limitation line as delivered content at the top, plus a MarkerRule and a QuoteRule stating that an element the source cannot support is omitted rather than invented
assessment: The file's flagship positive example fabricated four timestamps and a verbatim quotation from an input that supplied neither, ran 81 words against its own 90-word floor while certifying itself as compliant, and flattened a doubly-hedged prediction into an unqualified universal claim; the fix installs a four-tier Evidence Provenance Protocol that makes Tier D unanalysable, an ObservationBoundary listing what no transcript can support, an Attribution Grammar preserving the speaker's hedges and scope conditions, and two new 100% dimensions for timestamp integrity and attribution discipline.

example_defects_found: A2 INTERNALLY-CONSISTENT FABRICATION in the Fermi example: 72+120+42=234 is correct, 84/234=35.9% is correct, and the sanity check PASSED, but the benchmark it cited FALSIFIES the assumption it was validating. 54e9 US notes / 335e6 people = 161 per person and 30e9 euro notes / 350e6 = 86, against an assumed high-income density of 60. The check never asked what the benchmark implied about the input, only what fraction of the estimate it was. Recalibrating density_high to the benchmark-derived 123 raises the estimate 234B to 363.6B, a 55% increase
the same sanity check compared a note-COUNT share to a GDP share, two different quantities, with no stated reason they should correspond
WELCH EXAMPLE df WRONG: reported ~12.8; Welch-Satterthwaite on the stated inputs gives 774.694/58.836 = 13.167. The code was correct and the annotated result was fabricated

WELCH CI WRONG: reported [-16.5,+6.5]; correct is -5 +/- 2.157*5.2757 = -5 +/- 11.38 = [-16.4,+6.4]. The stated bounds imply t_crit 2.180 and df ~12.3, matching neither the true df nor the one the draft itself reported
the reported CI corresponded to NO variable in the code block: no interval was ever computed, violating the file own Computational Transparency rule
POWER WRONG BY ~2x: reported ~30%; noncentral t at d=0.42 with n=12,10 gives ~16%. The sanity check then declared PASS on the strength of this wrong figure
t reported as -0.947; true value -0.94774 which rounds to -0.948 (truncation not rounding)

Cohens d computed from a POOLED SD while Welch was selected precisely because variances are unequal: a pooled standardizer assumes the homogeneity the test was chosen to avoid. No arithmetic check catches this
d=0.428 labelled a medium effect; Cohen convention puts medium at 0.5
normality/independence/outliers listed as assumptions although NONE is checkable from n, mean, SD, with no acknowledgement
non-significant result reported as fail to reject with no statement of what the interval permits and no sample size that would resolve it (86 to 91 per group for 80% power)
other_fixes: QUICK_START said Seven dimensions; now Eight with Inferential Discipline added
stale cross-reference: Conflict Resolution Protocol cited as Section 5 when CONSTRAINTS is Section 6; corrected, zero Section 5 refs remain
vague See QUALITY_DIMENSIONS thresholds replaced with explicit per-dimension lists in SELF_REFINE, ITERATIVE_PROCESS, FLEXIBILITY Defaults
ConvergenceHeuristics said stop on any signal; hard guard added requiring both 100% dimensions plus recomputation of every prose number
threshold-exceeds-top-anchor resolved via CalibrationNote clarifying that for 100% dimensions the 95% column describes the passing state

Sanity Check verdict extended from binary PASS/FAIL to PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE, with INCONCLUSIVE required when the benchmark was consumed by calibration; this is the fallback the circular-anchor rule demands
unmeasurable ImprovementTarget (>=20% vs unstructured response) replaced with a 7-item countable pass/fail gate
6 new ErrorRecoveryProtocol recoveries incl. benchmark-inside-the-model and number-with-no-variable
METRICS renamed Sanity Check Coverage to Sanity Check Quality to match QUALITY_DIMENSIONS, added Inferential Discipline
ConflictResolutionProtocol renumbered to 6 with Inferential Honesty at level 2
TONE_AND_STYLE given optional=false
assessment: Both worked examples were quantitatively wrong in ways that read as correct: the Fermi sanity check passed while its own benchmark falsified the assumption it was checking, and the Welch example misreported df, the confidence interval, and power by roughly a factor of two while its code was right; recomputation, p-value discipline, multiplicity, causal language, and unverifiable-assumption handling are now specified and every stated statistic has been re-derived.

A Preference Is Not A Defect principle with DEFECT/RISK/PREFERENCE labelling required on every finding
The Law Must Actually Say That principle (Jakob yields no statistics, Hick yields no absolute times, Miller does not govern visible options)

example_defects_found: positive example specified the inactive tab as iOS system gray 2 with contrast >= 4.5:1; #AEAEB2 on #FFFFFF computes to 2.21:1 by the sRGB formula, failing the 4.5:1 text bar AND the 3:1 non-text bar, in the file whose central discipline is exact specification

related and previously unstated: iOS systemBlue #007AFF on white computes to 4.02:1 and fails AA for body text, so the platform default tint cannot serve as the active label colour; now stated with the computed value
UX Strategy asserted roughly 78% of banking app sessions involve one of three tasks and credited Jakobs Law with confirming it; the figure is untraceable and Jakobs Law produces no session statistics

validation plan paired n=5 with SUS score >= 80, which a five-person sample cannot establish to useful precision: false rigor
Design Plan goal promised one tap to each task entry point while the validation thresholds measured 4-tap and 5-tap completion, so goal and test had drifted apart

edge_case example contained no Design Plan, no recommendations, no accessibility section and no validation roadmap, only prose about what the response would contain: it would score 0 on two 100% dimensions while labelled a positive example
edge_case example diagnosed 47 visible nav items as a Millers Law violation; Millers 7 plus or minus 2 concerns items held in short-term memory, not options visible on screen
the same Miller misapplication appeared in the DONTs, in the Specificity Compounds principle exemplar, and in the Tree-of-Thought evaluation criteria: four sites total
anti-example WhyWrong listed five violations without a count and missed the Evidence Integrity failure and the hamburger-menu platform error

ITERATIVE_PROCESS threshold and its step-4 confirm all >= 85% replaced
FLEXIBILITY Defaults quality threshold 85% across all dimensions replaced

Conflict Resolution xref made explicit as Section 6/CONSTRAINTS
Input Validation and Error Recovery protocols now referenced from the DOs
Process Integrity definition reconciled to name all six mandatory phases
TONE_AND_STYLE given optional=false

INTERNALLY-CONSISTENT FABRICATION (A2): Goal 1 read 'reduce communication-related support tickets by 30% (from 18% to <= 12.6% of total tickets)'. 18 x 0.7 = 12.6 is arithmetically perfect against itself and passes any internal-consistency check, but the metric is a SHARE: cutting those tickets also shrinks the total, so a 30% reduction lands the share at 12.6/94.6 = 13.32%, not 12.6%. Reaching 12.6% would require a 34.3% cut. The error was replicated in the KPI table and the Benefits section

UNIT AMBIGUITY: 'Improve on-time delivery completion rate by 8% (from 87% to >= 94%)' resolves to 93.96% relative or 95% in percentage points; the document silently picked relative and then rounded up to 94%.
